extraction.text:
Jolly Jain

Certified Business Analyst 9817219345 | gal.bbps@gmail.com

Professional Summary

Experienced professional with 10yrs of experience in Business Analysis/ Project Management and Operations across Banking, Fintech & SaaS. Well-versed in SDLC with Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Strong expertise in requirement gathering, sprint planning, backlog management, Finastra GPP, and API analysis with proven experience delivering projects end-to-end from planning to closure.

Core Skills

Business Analysis: Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering, Stakeholder Management, Process Mapping, Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis Documentation: BRD, FRD, Use Cases, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria Methodologies: Agile (Scrum), Waterfall, SDLC Testing & Delivery: UAT Planning & Execution, Defect Management, Business Sign-Off Domain: Payments, Client Onboarding Tools: JIRA, Confluence, MS Excel, Sharepoint, MySQL, Power BI, Tableau, Postman, Visio

Professional Experience

Star Lite InfoTech Ltd.| Business Analyst | Remote Project: ISO 20022 Migration

Mar’22 – Dec’24

Supported the migration of payment messaging from SWIFT MT to ISO20022 MX formats, aligning with SWIFT CBPR+ and regulatory mandates. Conducted requirement analysis, message mapping, and UAT coordination to enable seamless and accurate payment processing.

Responsibilities:



Supported end-to-end ISO2022 migration initiative for cross-border and domestic payments, ensuring compliance with SWIFT and regulatory standards.

Gathered and documented business and functional requirements for payment message transformation using BRD, FRD, User Stories and Process Flows.



Performed message mapping and gap analysis between MT (MT103, MT202, MT195 etc.) and MX standards (pacs.008, pacs.009, camt.053 etc.) to ensure accurate data translation.



Conducted As-Is and To-Be analysis for payments transformation workflows

Defined business rules and functional requirements for MT-MX message conversion aligned with SWIFT CBPR+ standards



Facilitated requirement workshops with business, compliance, operations and IT stakeholders



Collaborated with QA and development teams to validate payment workflows and resolve defects during SIT/UAT phases



Experienced in Agile Scrum, breaking down requirements into epics, features, and user stories



Analyzed payment exceptions and reconciliation gaps to ensure seamless payment processing



Created document for the new processes and systems, including user manuals and technical guides

Tide | Business Analyst | Hyderabad Project: Client Onboarding & Screening Management

June’21-Feb’22

The project was about implementing a client life cycle management system to streamline client onboarding with KYC, AML, Sanctions & Due Diligence checks, ensuring compliance with global regulations and improving efficiency, data quality & client experience.

Responsibilities:

• Gathered and documented requirements for Client Onboarding, KYC, AML, and sanctions screening processes ensuring

alignment with project scope, objectives and deliverable.

• Worked with compliance and operations teams to automate client onboarding workflows, reducing onboarding

time by 40%

Designed and validated screening rules for PEP and sanction list checks



Identified key stakeholders, analyzed their power on the project, and strategically engaged them throughout the project



Collaborated with compliance, operations, and technology teams to streamline onboarding workflows and improve operational efficiency



Prepared user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation for onboarding and screening modules



Participated in scrum meetings (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) with Development Team, Product Owner



Supported SIT/UAT activities and validated KYC, AML, and sanctions screening workflows.

Analyzed onboarding bottlenecks and contributed to automation initiatives reducing manual intervention

WNS Global Services Pvt Ltd. | Lead Associate | Gurugram

May’20-Jan’21

Project: SMSA (Swift Message Search Application)

Worked on the development of a SWIFT Message Search Application enabling users to quickly access, validate, and track

SWIFT MT/MX messages; improving reconciliation and compliance with SWIFT standards.

Responsibilities:

Gathered & documented business requirements for searching and retrieving SWIFT MT & ISO20022 messages to support payments investigation and compliance team

Designed functional and non-functional requirements including search filters (by date, sender/receiver, transaction ref., amount, payment status)



Elicited & translated business requirements into User Stories and assigned them to Sprints in Agile Methodology

Worked with development team to validate messages



Conducted Impact Analysis on Business Process using techniques like Use Case Diagram

Designed Requirement Traceability Matrix(RTM) to manage requirements



Involved in creating wireframes and mockups for the system using MS VISIO



Responsible for coordinating and scheduling meetings, workshops, and other project-related gatherings



Provided ongoing support to users and stakeholders to address any issues, challenges related to SWIFT Messages

Used JIRA for bug tracking and reporting, also followed up with the development team to verify bug fixes

Saxo Group India Pvt Ltd | Sr. Associate | Gurugram Profile: Cash & Payments Ops

Jul’17-Apr’19

Responsibilities:



Strong understanding of MT messages, cross-border payments, payment lifecycle, and clearing/settlement processes



Knowledgeable in payment message standards (MT103, MT202, MT199, MT192, MT196, MT195) and clearing houses (BACS, CHAPS, EBA, Fedwire, SEPA, TARGET, RTGS, NEFT)

Good understanding of Letter of credit (LC), Guarantees.

Manager cross-border payment operations and ensured compliance with international payment standards and settlement process.

Handled payment investigations, SWIFT message validation, and exception handling for global transactions

• Contributed to operational efficiency and STP improvement initiatives within payment processing workflows.

Natwest Group | Analyst | Gurugram Profile: SWIFT Payments Ops

Responsibilities:

Managed end-to-end payment processing operations across retail, corporate, and institutional banking channels while ensuring SLA and regulatory compliance.



Investigated payment exceptions and SWIFT-related queries to ensure timely resolutions and minimize operational risk



Supported payment reconciliation and manual payment validation processes for high-value transactions



Contributed to STP improvement initiatives increasing automation efficiency from 40%-80%



Tracking to ensure all the enquiries and manual payments are processed well within agreed timeline



Awarded for process improvement in order to serve better services to customers



Recovered loss of 50 million GBP

Education

MBA- Sikkim Manipal University

2016



B.Com- Delhi University

2013

Certifications



ECBA- IIBA Certified Business Analysis



Diploma in French Language

Jan’14-Jun’17

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Professional Summary
Experienced professional with 10yrs of experience in Business Analysis/ Project Management and Operations across Banking, Fintech & SaaS. Well-versed in SDLC with Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Strong expertise in requirement gathering, sprint planning, backlog management, Finastra GPP, and API analysis with proven experience delivering projects end-to-end from planning to closure.
Profile: Cash & Payments Ops
Jul’17-Apr’19
Responsibilities:

Strong understanding of MT messages, cross-border payments, payment lifecycle, and clearing/settlement processes

Knowledgeable in payment message standards (MT103, MT202, MT199, MT192, MT196, MT195) and clearing houses (BACS, CHAPS, EBA, Fedwire, SEPA, TARGET, RTGS, NEFT)
Good understanding of Letter of credit (LC), Guarantees.
Manager cross-border payment operations and ensured compliance with international payment standards and settlement process.
Handled payment investigations, SWIFT message validation, and exception handling for global transactions
• Contributed to operational efficiency and STP improvement initiatives within payment processing workflows.
Natwest Group | Analyst | Gurugram Profile: SWIFT Payments Ops
Responsibilities:
Managed end-to-end payment processing operations across retail, corporate, and institutional banking channels while ensuring SLA and regulatory compliance.

Investigated payment exceptions and SWIFT-related queries to ensure timely resolutions and minimize operational risk

Supported payment reconciliation and manual payment validation processes for high-value transactions

Contributed to STP improvement initiatives increasing automation efficiency from 40%-80%

Tracking to ensure all the enquiries and manual payments are processed well within agreed timeline

Awarded for process improvement in order to serve better services to customers

Recovered loss of 50 million GBP

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Professional Experience
Star Lite InfoTech Ltd.| Business Analyst | Remote Project: ISO 20022 Migration
Mar’22 – Dec’24
Supported the migration of payment messaging from SWIFT MT to ISO20022 MX formats, aligning with SWIFT CBPR+ and regulatory mandates. Conducted requirement analysis, message mapping, and UAT coordination to enable seamless and accurate payment processing.
Responsibilities:

Supported end-to-end ISO2022 migration initiative for cross-border and domestic payments, ensuring compliance with SWIFT and regulatory standards.
Gathered and documented business and functional requirements for payment message transformation using BRD, FRD, User Stories and Process Flows.

Performed message mapping and gap analysis between MT (MT103, MT202, MT195 etc.) and MX standards (pacs.008, pacs.009, camt.053 etc.) to ensure accurate data translation.

Conducted As-Is and To-Be analysis for payments transformation workflows
Defined business rules and functional requirements for MT-MX message conversion aligned with SWIFT CBPR+ standards

Facilitated requirement workshops with business, compliance, operations and IT stakeholders

Collaborated with QA and development teams to validate payment workflows and resolve defects during SIT/UAT phases

Experienced in Agile Scrum, breaking down requirements into epics, features, and user stories

Analyzed payment exceptions and reconciliation gaps to ensure seamless payment processing

Created document for the new processes and systems, including user manuals and technical guides
Tide | Business Analyst | Hyderabad Project: Client Onboarding & Screening Management
June’21-Feb’22
The project was about implementing a client life cycle management system to streamline client onboarding with KYC, AML, Sanctions & Due Diligence checks, ensuring compliance with global regulations and improving efficiency, data quality & client experience.
Responsibilities:
• Gathered and documented requirements for Client Onboarding, KYC, AML, and sanctions screening processes ensuring
alignment with project scope, objectives and deliverable.
• Worked with compliance and operations teams to automate client onboarding workflows, reducing onboarding
time by 40%
Designed and validated screening rules for PEP and sanction list checks

Identified key stakeholders, analyzed their power on the project, and strategically engaged them throughout the project

Collaborated with compliance, operations, and technology teams to streamline onboarding workflows and improve operational efficiency

Prepared user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation for onboarding and screening modules

Participated in scrum meetings (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) with Development Team, Product Owner

Supported SIT/UAT activities and validated KYC, AML, and sanctions screening workflows.
Analyzed onboarding bottlenecks and contributed to automation initiatives reducing manual intervention
WNS Global Services Pvt Ltd. | Lead Associate | Gurugram
May’20-Jan’21
Project: SMSA (Swift Message Search Application)
Worked on the development of a SWIFT Message Search Application enabling users to quickly access, validate, and track
SWIFT MT/MX messages; improving reconciliation and compliance with SWIFT standards.
Responsibilities:
Gathered & documented business requirements for searching and retrieving SWIFT MT & ISO20022 messages to support payments investigation and compliance team
Designed functional and non-functional requirements including search filters (by date, sender/receiver, transaction ref., amount, payment status)

Elicited & translated business requirements into User Stories and assigned them to Sprints in Agile Methodology
Worked with development team to validate messages

Conducted Impact Analysis on Business Process using techniques like Use Case Diagram
Designed Requirement Traceability Matrix(RTM) to manage requirements

Involved in creating wireframes and mockups for the system using MS VISIO

Responsible for coordinating and scheduling meetings, workshops, and other project-related gatherings

Provided ongoing support to users and stakeholders to address any issues, challenges related to SWIFT Messages
Used JIRA for bug tracking and reporting, also followed up with the development team to verify bug fixes
Saxo Group India Pvt Ltd | Sr. Associate | Gurugram
